title: Cinematic Scroll Storytelling
concept: Vesper Line, a fictional Lisbon-to-Innsbruck sleeper train, told as one 37-hour journey: boarding preloader, parallax night-sky hero with masked headline, scroll-scrubbed manifesto, a pinned night-to-dawn scene with a running clock, a sticky stack of window views and a parallax arrival footer.
notes: GSAP ScrollTrigger + Lenis (installed). A fixed journey HUD maps total scroll to the trip clock. The preloader is skipped under ?shot and prefers-reduced-motion; the night scene pins only above 900px. Photography from Unsplash, stored locally.
